Consequently no exponential-rarity hypothesis is needed when log m=o(D) and all widths are at most (D+1)/(theta_rho+eta), where theta_rho is the unique large root of H(theta)+2 theta log rho=0.

mao_boundary: For Mao's exact-zero-LDA noisy rank test, any read-k local-union representation must satisfy 1-o(1) <= k L_q + sqrt(k L_q B). Thus if k L_q=o(1), B >= (1-o(1))^2/(k L_q), and Mao cannot simultaneously have constant read, log m=o(D), and all local widths below the near-source-width threshold. No local rarity assumption is used.
